lines.text: Etoo the beetle and Bella the bee were best friends...
until one gust from Bella's wings knocked his sand tower down.
He was too angry to listen.
But being angry didn't make him feel better.
Then he remembered the wise old scorpion. When anger buzzes loud, pause... and listen to your heart.
Bella, I'm sorry I got so mad.
The Desert Buzz. A story about managing anger.
